release_notes:
🚀 Release Highlights

Improved application stability and performance.
Fixed PDF report generation and template resolution issues.
Enhanced Report Approval Workflow persistence.
Updated Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for Admin, Manager, and Operator accounts.
Improved enterprise deployment with ProgramData support.
Refined logging, backup, and runtime path management.
Enhanced PLC communication reliability (Modbus RTU & Modbus TCP support).
Various bug fixes and production readiness improvements.
This release focuses on stability, reliability, and enterprise deployment readiness for production environments.
